newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices down on rising arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices down on rising arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Wednesday fell to 1,104/1,105 rupees per quintal from 1,110 rupees on fresh speculative selling, dealers said.
Continued pressure of arrivals at the producing centres and sluggish overseas buying prompted fresh selling, cutting short a recent recovery.
Daily average arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained higher at 35,000/40,000 bags (75 kg each).
No trading took place in the September delivery but some traders were offering September delivery at 1,175/1,180 rupees per quintal.
Groundnut oil was steady at 364/365 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes. But demand remained low on reports of rising arrivals of imported palm oil at the Bombay port.
Imported palm oil fell by 2/3 rupees at 282/283 rupees per 10 kg on fresh arrivals of about 6,000 tonnes at Bombay port as well as a subdued trend in the world market.
